decision: No profile passed all fixed safeguards
physical_definition: Keep common-mass two-branch transport, lower mass fraction .25, fixed1km lower shear and upper/lower specific-humidity ratio .2. Only generic rain-activation rh_threshold changes from adopted .3677449 to fixed .5/.6/.7. No tau, rain multiplier, regional mask, Earth planetary or boundary forcing adjustment. The model column RH uses approximate saturated-column capacity, so these are plausible sensitivity values, not measured cloud-base relative humidities. Test whether delaying rainout improves delivery/placement; evaluate actual coupled solves, not offline rescaled rain.
scope: This plan is declared before the parent common-mass pilot completes and before any new threshold scores. Exactly3 humidity thresholds, fixed middle transport ratio .2; no added threshold/ratio candidates after outcomes. No climate/atlas adoption unless unchanged full31/ocean/fine/established6 and matched-world gates all pass. No city/global-score claim from these reused regions.
